title: 2026 Japan Cup (G1)
note: JRA labels the 2026 Japan Cup as 国際招待 (international invitational), directly supporting invitational-race usage. Eligibility and invitation mechanics remain race-specific.

title: Race programme changes 2025/26
note: BHA current programme guidance explicitly uses staying races and gives programme-specific thresholds for two-year-olds at 7f+ and three-year-olds at 10f+. Use as GB programme terminology, not a universal distance boundary.

title: Queensland harness racing barrier trials update
note: Official 2026 trial guidance gives priority to horses unqualified from a start type and horses that have not raced or passed a qualifying trial in the last six months, directly supporting qualification-trial function in harness racing.

title: NYRA names Rob MacLennan as Racing Secretary
note: NYRA states that its Racing Secretary oversees writing condition books and other duties across race meets, directly supporting the North American race-programme role.

title: Horsemen — Riders Up / Saddling Paddock
note: Keeneland states that riders are called to their mounts in the Saddling Paddock and horses may be saddled there before filing toward the track, directly supporting the pre-race saddling/mounting-area sense.

title: Rules of Racing — start and withdrawal provisions
note: Current BHA rules provide for horses to be withdrawn by the Starter or Stewards after coming under Starter's Orders; use for the late/on-course withdrawal sense without treating every non-runner as a late withdrawal.

title: Strengthened process for withdrawing horses now in force
note: BHA describes on-racecourse withdrawals close to the start and the Steward ratification process. Pair with current rules for the enduring procedural sense.
